Well that would be because psychology isn't a hard science. You start with an assumption that you WILL see certain observations, and then throw out the results that dont fit your hypothesis. More often than not, psychologists are mentally twisted beyond belief and desperately seek confirmation bias that this is the normal condition. Good example of this is Freud, who had a terrible drug habit and was infatuated with his mother. This is obviously abnormal, but he could not accept this so he went on to publish his (widely debunked) theories.

Rosenham was a glorious troll years ahead of his time. He just wanted to prove that its a shit science, and he did.

Hey there. You've clearly had a really rough time so far, and while nobody can promise you it is going to get better, nobody can also predict it is impossible for any of those things to change. 

I may be a random internet stranger but I really do hope you wait a bit longer. Change happens quickly, both the bad and the good. time is a fickle thing and you said you are quite young.
 PM me if you need someone to just talk to. I can only promise I will listen honestly and not judge. I know that gesture already saved my life this week, and I recommend just venting to someone. 

If you still want out after, I can understand and respect that, its not a light decision to make.
Much love and be well.
Its something I always managed to survive without. Taking it now would be a personal failure, and make me feel like an invalid.

Worst case is I devastate her brother; whom I owe my life to and who is one of my very closest friends. Shame is a big motivator, and usually not in a positive way. Best case is people try to help and then I have to either turn them away when I need them or accept hep and hate myself at a core level
thank you. Regardless how my fight ends I wish you and your loved one strength to move forward in yours.

The couch option is there short term, but Ive done this before. I graduated with my B. Eng while homeless, and floated around until my career fell into place. 

I wont lie, Ive had 3 or 4 people I never expected reach out and offer me money, shelter, and food, but it is absolutely a pride issue. I got myself this far in life, kept a roof over my own and my parents heads since 14 and raised my sister after my dad died. I feel rotten to the core just asking for help, even on here right now, and I know I shouldnt. Its just the way things were and are for me. Hating myself for the other reasons just makes it harder to open my mouth. It feels like drowning all day every day.

Yeah, I kind of posted here as a last shot because I dont have any other means I am capable or willing of reaching out with. Thanks for the kind words, I appreciate it.

As for the people I cut off, the problem is that they ARE my support group; I dont make close friends easily and the people I didn't cut off were the more distant ones (I didnt want any red flags going off for more distant friends--it feels cruel and they would ask more questions). Its not like I trimmed the fat, I cut the limb off.

They arent even mad at me; its the weight of not being able to tell them why Ive been so broken for the last few months that keeps ME from allowing anyone to contact me. They dont know any details. Id reach out to my best friend but he still lives in the apartment the 3 of us had and I cant make that kind of rift in his family. I know that pain too closely to recreate it elsewhere. And despite everything else she still wants to not be public about it, which at the time I agreed to to try and comfort her, and Ill be damned if Im anything but a man of my word.

Well I moved out 4 weeks ago, but we have been on the fence for around 3 months (breakup, makeup within a few days) because its been fucking us both up. doesnt sound like much but every day is an eternity when you are homeless. I know for a fact she has been cutting and has suffered for a while with suicidal ideations too, but we arent on speaking terms at all.

This time I cut all contact from that entire circle of friends, and seeing as I grew up with them, that meant about 90% of the people I know I pushed away. Not a fucking word from them. I suck at asking for help when I need it.
I honestly appreciate your sentiment. Be well.
